calibration.method: SuperPoint + LightGlue / COLMAP sparse components, manually anchored metric frame
calibration.front_pose_assumption: View03 uses a local sparse relative-pose candidate. View05 and view06 are independently reviewed poses. View08 uses four reviewed tabletop corners and assumed dimensions. Shared front geometry and front-to-rear placement remain manual.
calibration.metric_scale: Rear endcap width 0.60m and top deck 1.32m are estimates
calibration.household_pose_note: Sparse two-track alignment and fitted bucket-only cameras were rejected. The shared bin positions are constrained in view02; view04 is an explicitly reviewed pose. Fit failures retained in household_fit_v10.json.

checkout_relative_pose.method: Local COLMAP component aligned to reviewed view05; similarity scale manually estimated
checkout_relative_pose.note: Only view03 relative-pose candidate retained; view05 and view06 keep independently reviewed poses after cross-view inspection.

limitations: No measured floor plan or surveyed scale.
Package crops are fixed UV appearances, not an exact SKU inventory.
The two-track household alignment was rejected; the reverse-camera link uses five tracks and remains uncertain.
Rear group and checkout group are independently anchored; no trustworthy automatic bridge. View04, view05 anchor, metric scale and view08 tabletop dimensions are reviewed estimates.
